item.title: Industry
item.description:
Andrej Karpathy

𝕏 @karpathy · karpathy.ai

Former Director of AI at Tesla, founding member of OpenAI, created Stanford’s CS231n deep learning course. Coined “vibe coding.” Recently released autoresearch — a 630-line Python tool that lets AI agents autonomously run ML experiments. One overnight run completed 126 experiments and dropped the “Time to GPT-2” benchmark by 11%. Currently says programming is “unrecognizable” now that agents work.

Evan You

𝕏 @youyuxi · evanyou.me
